Publication policy

A deliberately limited public view.

Who appears

The initial edition includes people whose master record contains explicit death evidence, plus Graham Freebody as the explicitly approved original author of the site.

What is withheld

Other living and uncertain person records, free-text notes, private identifiers, raw genealogy data and guestbook content are excluded.

Relationships

A family relationship is shown only through people independently eligible for publication. Withheld people are not named or represented as placeholders.

Photographs

All photographs preserved from the original website have been explicitly cleared for this public edition. Associations link only to independently eligible public person records.

Future additions

Older uncertain records and free-text notes can be added only through an explicit review and approval decision.
